summary: Review quasi-experimental causal designs for identifying assumptions, pre-trends/overlap, interference, specification sensitivity and estimand clarity.

must_inspect.why: The causal estimand depends on design-specific identifying assumptions, not only regression output.
false_positive_guards: Do not demand causal identification if claims are explicitly descriptive.

must_inspect.why: Design diagnostics should test assumptions that are empirically probeable.
false_positive_guards: Passing diagnostics does not prove untestable assumptions.

must_inspect.why: Specification choices can materially change a quasi-experimental estimate.
false_positive_guards: Do not require every robustness variant; focus on decisions that threaten the central claim.
Do not convert an unreported diagnostic into proof of failure.
